Title: Char-Broil Recalls Bistro Pro Electric Grills Due to Risk of Electric Shock
Description: This recall involves Char-Broil Bistro Pro electric grills sold for outdoor cooking.

Hazards.Name: The grounding wire for the grill's heating element can disconnect and lose fault protection, posing an electric shock hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled electric grills immediately and contact Char-Broil for a free repair kit.

Title: JKMAX Recalls Kids Bike Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
Description: This recall involves JKMAX kids bike helmets sold in multiple colors.

Hazards.Name: The helmets do not comply with the positional stability requirement and can fail to protect in a crash.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the helmets and contact JKMAX for a refund.

Manufacturers.Name: JKMAX Sports Co., Ltd., of China

Title: LANCHEZ Pressure Washers Recalled Due to Serious Risk of Injury
Description: This recall involves LANCHEZ electric pressure washers with a corded power supply.

Hazards.Name: The spray gun can detach under pressure and strike the user.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the pressure washers and contact LANCHEZ for a replacement.

Title: Esjay US Recalls Toddler Busy Board Montessori Toys Due to Choking Hazard
Description: This recall involves Esjay toddler busy board Montessori toys for children under three.

Hazards.Name: The recalled toy violates the small parts ban because the red knobs can detach, posing a choking hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should take the toy away from children and contact Esjay for a refund.

Products.Name: Esjay Toddler Busy Board Montessori Toys

Title: Colerinsec Recalls Jerify Magnetic Stick Figure Toy Sets Due to Magnet Ingestion Risk
Description: This recall involves Jerify magnetic humanoid toy sets sold in a 30 piece pack.

Hazards.Name: The magnetic humanoid toy sets can liberate loose high powered magnets posing an ingestion hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the toy sets and contact Colerinsec for a refund.

Products.Name: Jerify Magnetic Humanoid Toy Sets 30 PCS

Title: Victgoal Recalls Inflatable Pool Floats Due to Drowning Hazard
Description: This recall involves Victgoal inflatable pool floats sold in several color patterns.

Hazards.Name: The float can deflate unexpectedly and cause the user to fall into the water.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the pool floats and contact Victgoal for a refund.

Title: Zelbuck Childrens Chess Games Recalled Due to Magnet Ingestion Hazard
Description: This recall involves Zelbuck childrens chess games with magnetic pieces.

Hazards.Name: The chess pieces contain loose magnets that pose an ingestion hazard to children.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the chess games and contact Zelbuck for a refund.

Title: Northwind Ceramic Space Heaters Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
Description: This recall involves Northwind ceramic space heaters with a tip over switch.

Hazards.Name: The heater can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should unplug the heater immediately and contact Northwind for a refund.

Title: Esjay Cordless Mini Chainsaws Recalled Due to Laceration Hazard
Description: This recall involves Esjay cordless mini chainsaws sold with a battery and charger.

Hazards.Name: The chain can continue to move after the trigger is released, posing a laceration hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the chainsaw and contact Esjay for a refund.

Title: LANCHEZ Baby Bath Seats Recalled Due to Fall and Drowning Hazards
Description: This recall involves LANCHEZ baby bath seats with suction cup bases.

Hazards.Name: The bath seat can tip over while in use, posing fall and drowning hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the bath seat and contact LANCHEZ for a refund.

Title: Acme Stainless Steel Water Bottles Recalled Due to Lead Exposure Hazard
Description: This recall involves Acme stainless steel insulated water bottles in several sizes.

Hazards.Name: The outer base can contain levels of lead that exceed the federal limit.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the water bottles and contact Acme for a refund.

Title: Zenith Wireless Earbuds Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
Description: This recall involves Zenith wireless earbuds sold with a charging case.

Hazards.Name: The lithium ion battery in the charging case can overheat and ignite.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the earbuds and contact Zenith for a refund.
